A '''Pyro grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] that caused a large fiery explosion. During the [[Vaklin insurgency]], a [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] insurgent attempted to throw one at [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and his troops, only to have it backfire. Vader [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] made it impossible for the Duros to release it from his hand.
